description:
The Firmstrong Bella Classic Single Speed is a fashionable cruiser bicycle designed for the rider who wants a great functional bike while making a stylish statement. This model comes fully equipped with all the premium details that make our cruisers stand out, including painted wheels, front and rear fenders, and beautiful Hawaiian flower decals. The sleek frame design and coordinated accessories give the Bella a high-end look, making it the perfect choice for those who want a women's bicycle that is as much a fashion accessory as it is a reliable mode of transportation.

What sets the Bella Single Speed apart is its emphasis on absolute simplicity and ease of use. As a women’s coaster bike, it features a clean design with no complicated gears or messy cables hanging off the frame. This makes it an ideal choice for riders who want a low-maintenance experience where they can just hop on and go. The braking system is a traditional coaster brake, which means you simply pedal backwards to stop, just like the original beach cruisers you remember. This intuitive setup makes the Bella one of the most beginner-friendly coaster brake bicycles available, allowing you to focus entirely on the scenery rather than technical controls.

Despite its simple configuration, the Bella is engineered to be efficient and versatile for recreational riding. The wide cruiser tires and dual-spring saddle work together to absorb the shock from bumps in the road, ensuring your ride is soft and comfortable even on uneven pavement. While it is perfect for cruising at a steady pace of five to fifteen miles per hour on flat terrain, the efficient geometry of the frame makes it surprisingly capable of handling light inclines as well. Built with a durable steel frame and an ergonomic upright riding position, the Bella Classic Single Speed is a high-quality women's cruiser bicycle that lets you express your personal style while enjoying a relaxed, effortless ride.

15” Steel Frame with 26” Aluminum Wheels

Single Speed Bike with a Pedal-Backwards Coaster Brake for easy pedaling and smooth braking

Dual Spring Oversized Cruiser Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provides a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

Front and Rear Fenders with a Cruiser Bend Style Handlebar

Bicycle Weighs 36lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Women and Girls 5'2" - 6' Tall­

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 15 miles in a single trip

Training Wheels can easily be installed if needed

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 80% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
